name: comp-170
title: Billing Period Toggle
description: A two-part switch for monthly or yearly billing that slides a raised block under the chosen half. The yearly side shows a green -20% note while it is active, and the other label fades to grey.
use: On a pricing page or checkout, when a buyer should compare a monthly and a yearly charge.
avoid: Only two fixed labels with one hardcoded discount; a third cycle or per-plan prices need edits in the file.
a11y: Both halves are real radios reached with arrow keys, and the moving block shows a focus ring; the 300ms slide ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark track holds two labels side by side: Bill Monthly, then Bill Yearly with a small -20% beside it. The chosen half sits on a lighter raised block with bold white text, while the idle label fades back.
behaves: Clicking either half slides the lighter block across in about a third of a second and dims the label it leaves. The recording opens on yearly, moves to monthly, then returns to yearly.
customise: Both labels, the -20% note and the starting choice are written in the file; change them there. Slide time, easing curve and the green accent are classes in the same file.
weight: light: Two labels over a single pseudo-element that slides; idle once a choice is made.
